summary.text: 峠 is a Japanese-created character for a mountain pass, read tōge. 山 gives the setting; 上 and 下 express ascent and descent. Together they indicate the place where climbing turns into going downhill.

formation.text: Mountain, up and down contribute their meanings together; the analysis assigns no component a pronunciation role.

history.text: This is a Japanese formation from existing characters. Its meaning extends from a pass to the high point or critical stage of something. The Chinese use is a borrowing of the Japanese written form, with a spelling pronunciation assigned by comparison with 卡.
